name: 月誓 · 龙廷 2.0 — 夜幕浮雕
custom_css:
/* Moonveil 2.0.3 — A single asymmetric comic dragon. Original ST 1.19 theme. */
:root {
 --cc-accent: #b5acec; /* 色彩 / 月紫强调色 */
 --cc-silver: #c3c9df; /* 色彩 / 银质高光 */
 --cc-ink: #101625; /* 色彩 / 夜色底幕 */
 --cc-surface: #202637; /* 色彩 / 阅读底板 */
 --cc-message: #2c334a; /* 色彩 / 角色消息 */
 --cc-user: #302e46; /* 色彩 / 用户消息 */
 --cc-text: #d2d5e3; /* 色彩 / 正文 */
 --cc-muted: #a4acc4; /* 色彩 / 辅助文字 */
 --cc-line: #707b9c66; /* 色彩 / 分隔线 */
 --cc-art-opacity: .95; /* 立绘 / 不透明度 */
 --cc-ornament-opacity: .92; /* 装饰 / 银框强度 */
 --cc-dragon-width: min(74vw, 1040px, var(--sheldWidth,92vw)); /* 立绘 / 整只龙统一缩放 */
 --cc-stage-top: calc(var(--cc-dragon-width) * .258 + 12px); /* 布局 / 完整翼冠的顶部空间 */
 --cc-stage-bottom: 20px; /* 布局 / 底部留白 */
 --cc-chat-padding: clamp(20px, 2.2vw, 42px); /* 阅读 / 正文外边距 */
 --cc-message-gap: 26px; /* 阅读 / 消息间距 */
 --cc-font-size: 20px; /* 阅读 / 字号 */
 --cc-line-height: 1.9; /* 阅读 / 行高 */
 --cc-message-padding: 20px; /* 阅读 / 消息内边距 */
 --cc-avatar-size: 62px; /* 头像 / 图片尺寸 */
 --cc-avatar-gap: 30px; /* 头像 / 与正文的距离 */
 --cc-drawer-width: 580px; /* 设置 / 常规面板宽度 */
 --cc-settings-width: 1020px; /* 设置 / 多列面板宽度 */
 --cc-nav-size: 54px; /* 工具栏 / 宽度 */
 --cc-panel-width: min(var(--sheldWidth,92vw),calc(100dvw - 106px - var(--cc-dragon-width) * .155));
 --cc-panel-left: min(calc((100dvw - var(--cc-panel-width)) / 2 + 12px),calc(100dvw - var(--cc-panel-width) - var(--cc-dragon-width) * .155 - 16px));
 --cc-frame-art: url("data:image/webp;base64,");
 --SmartThemeBodyColor: var(--cc-text); --SmartThemeEmColor:#b6bbd8; --SmartThemeQuoteColor:#bcb2e8; --SmartThemeUnderlineColor:var(--cc-accent); --SmartThemeBorderColor:var(--cc-line); --SmartThemeBlurTintColor:#202637; --SmartThemeChatTintColor:var(--cc-surface); --SmartThemeUserMesBlurTintColor:var(--cc-user); --SmartThemeBotMesBlurTintColor:var(--cc-message);
}
html{background:var(--cc-ink);color-scheme:dark}
body{background:var(--cc-ink);color:var(--cc-text);font-family:"Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI",sans-serif;text-shadow:none}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;background:url("data:image/webp;base64,") left top/cover no-repeat;opacity:.82}
#bg1,#bg2{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
#top-bar{background:transparent;backdrop-filter:none;box-shadow:none;pointer-events:none}
/* Native width is capped to leave room for the complete, uniformly scaled right wing. */
/* One transparent dragon: horizontal rim y=.258W, side rim x=.845W. */
#sheld{position:fixed;z-index:30;top:var(--cc-stage-top);bottom:var(--cc-stage-bottom);right:auto;left:var(--cc-panel-left);width:var(--cc-panel-width);height:auto;max-height:none;max-width:none;min-width:0;min-height:0;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:visible;border:1px solid #858ba5;border-radius:9px;background:var(--cc-surface);backdrop-filter:none;box-shadow:0 16px 45px #0008}
#sheld::before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:10;pointer-events:none;width:var(--cc-dragon-width);aspect-ratio:1902/827;height:auto;right:calc(var(--cc-dragon-width) * -.155);bottom:calc(100% - var(--cc-dragon-width) * .177);background:url("data:image/webp;base64,") center/contain no-repeat;opacity:var(--cc-art-opacity);filter:drop-shadow(0 9px 5px #070d1dcc)}
#sheld::after{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:9;pointer-events:none;inset:-12px;border:78px solid transparent;border-image:var(--cc-frame-art) 32% / 78px / 0 stretch;opacity:var(--cc-ornament-opacity)}
#sheldheader{top:10px;left:12px;z-index:12}
#chat{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;max-height:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;margin-top:clamp(32px,calc(var(--cc-dragon-width) * .125),130px);padding:14px max(var(--cc-chat-padding),calc(var(--cc-dragon-width) * .11)) 12px var(--cc-chat-padding);background:none;backdrop-filter:none;text-shadow:none;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#64729566 transparent;scroll-padding:24px}
#chat .mes{position:relative;display:flex;flex:0 0 auto;flex-direction:row;align-items:flex-start;gap:var(--cc-avatar-gap);box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;max-width:none;min-width:0;margin:0 0 var(--cc-message-gap);padding:12px 5px 4px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;box-shadow:none;text-shadow:none;color:var(--cc-text)}
#chat .mes .mes_block{flex:1 1 0;width:auto;min-width:0;padding:0}
#chat .mesAvatarWrapper{flex:0 0 var(--cc-avatar-size);width:var(--cc-avatar-size);padding:8px 0 0}
#chat .mes>.avatar{flex:0 0 var(--cc-avatar-size);margin-top:8px}
#chat .mes .avatar{position:relative;isolation:isolate;box-sizing:border-box;width:var(--cc-avatar-size);height:var(--cc-avatar-size);max-width:none;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#29314b;overflow:visible;box-shadow:none}
#chat .mes .avatar::after{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;inset:-32%;background:url("data:image/webp;base64,") center/contain no-repeat;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 2px #090c1e)}
#chat .mes .avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;max-height:none;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%}
#chat .mes .ch_name{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:26px;margin:0 0 8px;padding:0 2px;border:0;color:var(--cc-silver)}
#chat .mes .name_text{margin:0;color:var(--cc-silver);font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600}
#chat .mes .timestamp{margin:0;color:var(--cc-muted);font-size:10px;font-weight:400}
#chat .mes .mes_buttons{color:var(--cc-muted);margin-left:auto;gap:6px;font-size:13px}
#chat .mes .mes_buttons .mes_button{min-width:24px;min-height:24px;padding:4px}
#chat .mes .mes_button:hover{color:#e1ddff;background:#8283b62b;border-radius:4px}
#chat .mes .mes_text{box-sizing:border-box;padding:var(--cc-message-padding);border:1px solid #747c9b26;border-radius:4px 14px 14px 14px;background:var(--cc-message);color:var(--cc-text);font-size:calc(var(--cc-font-size) * var(--fontScale,1));line-height:var(--cc-line-height);max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere;text-shadow:none}
#chat .mes[is_user=true] .mes_text{background:var(--cc-user);border-color:#8f7aa52b}
#chat .mes[is_system=true] .mes_text{background:#242c3d}
#chat .mes .mes_text p{margin:0 0 14px}#chat .mes .mes_text p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
#chat .mes .mes_text :is(h1,h2,h3){color:#d5d8e8;line-height:1.5;margin:18px 0 10px}
#chat .mes .mes_text strong{color:#e1ddea}#chat .mes .mes_text em{color:#b6bbd8}
#chat .mes .mes_text :is(q,q em){color:#bcb2e8}
#chat .mes .mes_text a{color:#b6c6ed;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
#chat .mes .mes_text blockquote{margin:16px 0;padding:10px 18px;border-left:3px solid #8a7caf;background:#151d3033;color:#bfb7dc}
#chat .mes .mes_text pre{box-sizing:border-box;max-width:100%;margin:16px 0;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;background:#161d2e;color:#c3cce0;border:1px solid #616d924f;border-radius:7px}
#chat .mes .mes_text pre code{background:none;color:inherit;font:13px/1.7 Consolas,monospace;white-space:pre;word-break:normal;overflow-wrap:normal}
#chat .mes .mes_text :not(pre)>code{background:#11182760;color:#c2badf;padding:2px 5px;border-radius:3px}
#chat .mes .mes_text table{width:100%;max-width:100%;table-layout:fixed;border-collapse:collapse;margin:16px 0;font-size:14px}
#chat .mes .mes_text :is(th,td){padding:10px;border:1px solid #7782a24f;text-align:left;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#chat .mes .mes_text th{background:#42496166;color:#d4d7e4}
#chat .mes .mes_text :is(img,video,iframe){max-width:100%}
#chat .mes .mes_reasoning_details{margin:0 0 12px;border:1px solid #776c9566;border-radius:8px;background:#26293e}
#chat .mes .mes_reasoning_summary{padding:10px 14px;color:#b9b0d6;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}
#chat .mes .mes_reasoning{padding:12px 16px;color:#b1b8ce;font-size:14px;line-height:1.8}
#chat .mes .mes_text details{margin:14px 0;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--cc-line);border-radius:6px}
#chat .mes .mes_text summary{cursor:pointer;color:#c1b6e7}
#chat .mes :is(.edit_textarea,.reasoning_edit_textarea){width:100%;min-height:140px;padding:16px;color:var(--cc-text);background:#242b41;border:1px solid #8a83b3;font-size:var(--cc-font-size)}
#chat .mes :is(.mesIDDisplay,.mes_timer,.tokenCounterDisplay){color:var(--cc-muted);font-size:10px}
#chat .mes .swipeRightBlock{bottom:0;right:10px;font-size:11px}#chat .mes :is(.swipe_left,.swipe_right){color:#b9add8}
/* Writing strip; native quick replies and send/stop visibility remain owned by ST. */
#form_sheld{flex:0 0 auto;width:100%;min-width:0;margin:0}
#send_form{position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;flex:0 0 auto;width:100%;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:0;margin:0;padding:14px 20px 16px;border:0;border-top:1px solid #737e9a88;border-radius:0 0 8px 8px;background:#202536;backdrop-filter:none;box-shadow:none}
#send_form::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-8px 0 -4px;border:22px solid transparent;border-image:var(--cc-frame-art) 32% / 32px / 0 stretch;pointer-events:none;opacity:var(--cc-ornament-opacity)}
#nonQRFormItems{align-items:flex-end;gap:10px;width:100%;min-width:0}
#send_textarea{box-sizing:border-box;flex:1 1 0;width:auto;min-width:0;min-height:48px;max-height:160px;height:auto;padding:10px 14px;color:var(--cc-text);background:#252c40;border:1px solid #7785aa55;border-radius:6px;font:16px/1.7 "Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI",sans-serif;resize:vertical;box-shadow:none}
#send_textarea::placeholder{color:#99a3bf;opacity:1}
#leftSendForm,#rightSendForm{flex:0 0 auto;gap:4px}
#leftSendForm>div,#rightSendForm>div:not(.mes_stop){width:36px;min-height:44px;height:auto;color:#b6b8d6}
#send_but{color:#ddd8fb;background:#534789;border:3px double #b6b1d6;border-radius:50%;opacity:1;box-shadow:0 3px 6px #060a1777}
#send_but:hover{background:#64559d}#send_form .mes_stop{color:#c7b6df}
#send_form>button{flex:0 0 38px;min-height:44px;color:#bcb7d7}#send_form>button:last-child{margin-left:10px;border:3px double #b6b1d6;border-radius:50%;background:#534789}
/* No transform/filter on this ancestor: fixed native drawers must use viewport coordinates. */
#top-settings-holder,.demo-top{position:fixed;z-index:4000;top:min(var(--cc-stage-top),max(24px,calc(100dvh - 510px)));left:18px;right:auto;bottom:auto;width:var(--cc-nav-size);height:auto;max-height:calc(100dvh - 48px);margin:0;padding:16px 5px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:stretch;gap:7px;border:1px solid #8e92af;border-radius:9px;background:#232a3eee;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #0e162966,0 8px 18px #0006;backdrop-filter:none}
/* Ornament sits outside the icon hit areas; no containing block on the drawer ancestor. */
#top-settings-holder::before,.demo-top::before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:1;inset:-9px;pointer-events:none;border:20px solid transparent;border-image:var(--cc-frame-art) 32% / 24px / 0 stretch;opacity:var(--cc-ornament-opacity);filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 2px #070d1daa)}
#top-settings-holder>.drawer{width:100%;min-width:0;height:35px;flex:0 0 auto}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-icon{color:#bcb9dc;font-size:19px;padding:7px}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-icon.closedIcon{opacity:.85}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-icon:is(.openIcon,:hover,:focus-visible){color:#e0d9ff;opacity:1;background:#7766aa55;border-radius:6px;text-shadow:none}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content,#left-nav-panel,#right-nav-panel{box-sizing:border-box;position:fixed;left:88px;right:auto;top:24px;bottom:auto;width:min(var(--cc-drawer-width),calc(100dvw - 112px));min-width:0;max-width:calc(100dvw - 112px);max-height:calc(100dvh - 48px);margin:0;padding:26px;overflow-y:auto;border:14px solid transparent;border-image:var(--cc-frame-art) 32% / 30px / 0 stretch;border-radius:10px;background:#202637;color:var(--cc-text);box-shadow:14px 16px 45px #050916bb;backdrop-filter:none;z-index:4100;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#737b9c66 transparent}
#top-settings-holder :is(#user-settings-block,#rm_extensions_block,#AdvancedFormatting,#WorldInfo,#Backgrounds,#PersonaManagement){width:min(var(--cc-settings-width),calc(100dvw - 112px))}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content.maximized{left:88px!important;right:24px!important;top:24px!important;width:calc(100dvw - 112px)!important;max-width:calc(100dvw - 112px)!important}
#user-settings-block-content{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,250px),1fr));gap:24px;align-items:start}
#user-settings-block-content>div{width:100%;min-width:0}
#user-settings-block :is(.flex-container,.title_restorable,.checkbox_label),#UI-language-block{min-width:0}
#user-settings-block .checkbox_label{align-items:flex-start;gap:7px;padding:3px 0}
#user-settings-block .checkbox_label>span{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:break-word}
#user-settings-block :is(input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]),select,textarea){max-width:100%}
#user-settings-block #customCSS{min-height:160px;font-size:12px}
#rm_extensions_block :is(#extensions_settings,#extensions_settings2){flex:1 1 340px;min-width:0;width:auto}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content .menu_button{width:auto;min-width:0;max-width:100%;white-space:normal;word-break:normal;overflow-wrap:break-word;writing-mode:horizontal-tb;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid #7e87a655;background:#32394f;color:#ced0e0;box-shadow:none}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content .menu_button_icon{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content .inline-drawer-toggle{min-height:32px;padding:8px 10px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #68769355;border-radius:4px;background:#2b3349;color:#cacce0}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content :is(h3,h4){color:#cdd0e4;font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.02em}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content :is(select,textarea,input[type=text],input[type=number],input[type=search],input[type=password],.text_pole){box-sizing:border-box;color:#ced2e1;background:#161e30;border:1px solid #7782a161;border-radius:5px;padding:7px 9px;box-shadow:none}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content select{height:auto;min-height:33px}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content :is(input[type=checkbox],input[type=radio],input[type=range]){accent-color:#9586d1}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content .range-block-title{color:#b7bfd5;font-size:12px}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content input[type=range]{min-height:6px;height:6px!important;background:#665e8d!important;border:1px solid #9298b655;border-radius:4px!important;filter:none;box-shadow:none!important;margin:12px 0!important}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{width:17px;height:17px;background:#9281ce;border:2px solid #d0c9ec;box-shadow:0 2px 4px #0d1223}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{width:14px;height:14px;background:#9281ce;border:2px solid #d0c9ec;box-shadow:0 2px 4px #0d1223}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content :is(h4,.standoutHeader){background:#2b3349;background-image:none;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #6b789550;border-radius:4px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:10px}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content input[type=checkbox]{background:#20283d;border-color:#8d8dae;filter:none;--SmartThemeCheckboxTickColor:#e4ddff}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content input[type=checkbox]:checked{background:#7563aa;border-color:#aa9ad3}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content :is(.character_select,.group_select){border:1px solid #7280a044;border-radius:7px;margin:5px 0;background:#293148}
#top-settings-holder .drawer-content :is(.character_select,.group_select):hover{border-color:#a195ce;background:#363954}
.popup{background:#202637;border:1px solid #8890aa;border-radius:9px;color:#d2d5e3}
:is(#sheld,#top-settings-holder,.drawer-content) :is(button,a,input,select,textarea,[tabindex]):focus-visible{outline:2px solid #b5a2f0;outline-offset:3px}
@media(max-width:900px){
 :root{--cc-stage-top:calc(64px + var(--cc-dragon-width) * .258);--cc-stage-bottom:12px;--cc-dragon-width:min(88vw,580px);--cc-chat-padding:20px;--cc-avatar-size:42px;--cc-avatar-gap:22px;--cc-message-padding:16px;--cc-message-gap:22px}
 :root{--cc-panel-width:min(var(--sheldWidth,92vw),calc(100dvw - 24px - var(--cc-dragon-width) * .155));--cc-panel-left:min(calc((100dvw - var(--cc-panel-width)) / 2),calc(100dvw - var(--cc-panel-width) - var(--cc-dragon-width) * .155 - 12px))}
 /* Keep the corner grip and full wings on narrow screens by reserving a slim outside margin. */
 #sheld::after{inset:-8px;border-image-width:30px}#chat{margin-top:calc(var(--cc-dragon-width) * .195);padding:14px var(--cc-chat-padding) 12px}
 #top-settings-holder,.demo-top{top:8px;left:12px;right:12px;width:auto;min-height:44px;max-height:none;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;padding:4px 8px;gap:2px;border-radius:7px}
 #top-settings-holder::before,.demo-top::before{inset:-5px;border-width:14px;border-image-width:18px}
 #top-settings-holder>.drawer{flex:1 1 0;width:auto;min-width:0;height:32px}#top-settings-holder .drawer-icon{font-size:17px;padding:6px 3px}
 #top-settings-holder .drawer-content,#top-settings-holder :is(#user-settings-block,#rm_extensions_block,#AdvancedFormatting,#WorldInfo,#Backgrounds,#PersonaManagement),#left-nav-panel,#right-nav-panel{left:12px;right:12px;top:64px;width:auto;min-width:0;max-width:calc(100dvw - 24px);max-height:calc(100dvh - 76px);padding:16px;border-width:10px;border-image-width:24px}
 #top-settings-holder .drawer-content.maximized{left:12px!important;right:12px!important;top:64px!important;width:calc(100dvw - 24px)!important;max-width:calc(100dvw - 24px)!important}
 #send_form{padding:12px}#leftSendForm>div,#rightSendForm>div:not(.mes_stop){width:30px;min-height:42px}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
 :root{--cc-font-size:17px;--cc-line-height:1.85;--cc-chat-padding:13px;--cc-avatar-size:34px;--cc-avatar-gap:16px;--cc-message-padding:14px}
 #user-settings-block-content{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}:root{--cc-panel-left:10px;--cc-panel-width:calc(100dvw - 20px - var(--cc-dragon-width) * .155)}
 #chat{padding-top:14px}#chat .mes{flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:8px}#chat .mes .mes_block{flex-basis:100%}
 #chat .mes .mesAvatarWrapper{position:absolute;top:4px;left:10px;padding:0}
 #chat .mes .ch_name{min-height:38px;margin-bottom:10px;padding-left:60px;gap:4px}#chat .mes .timestamp{font-size:9px}#chat .mes .name_text{font-size:14px}
 #chat .mes .mes_text :is(th,td){padding:7px;font-size:12px}#send_textarea{min-height:46px;padding:10px}#nonQRFormItems{gap:5px}
}
@media(max-height:620px) and (max-width:900px){:root{--cc-dragon-width:min(88vw,580px,56dvh)}}
@media(max-height:620px) and (min-width:901px){:root{--cc-dragon-width:min(64vw,600px,75dvh);--cc-stage-bottom:14px}#top-settings-holder,.demo-top{top:24px;padding-block:8px;gap:2px}#chat{padding-top:10px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#sheld,#chat .mes{transition:none}}
